ruleDefinitions.name: Service StartupType Change Via Sc.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect the use of "sc.exe" to change the startup type of a service to "disabled" or "demand"

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "sc\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ config\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*start.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*disabled.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*demand.*"))))
